title: 自由曲面光學量測
summary: 以一片口徑 50 mm、對最佳擬合球面偏離 200 µm、最大斜率 20 mrad 的自由曲面反射鏡為案例：先說明無對稱軸的表面為何讓六個剛體自由度與面形誤差糾纏，必須靠基準與定位標記配準；再比較 CGH 零位干涉、傾斜波非零位干涉、接觸與光學探針輪廓儀及次口徑拼接的物理限制，建立含 CGH 寫入誤差、基板、回溯誤差與熱漂移的不確定度預算，最後以兩種獨立方法交叉驗證並把量測圖回饋到確定性修形與實測重最佳化。
summaryEn: Using a 50 mm freeform mirror with 200 µm departure from its best-fit sphere and 20 mrad maximum slope as the case, the course first shows why a surface without a symmetry axis entangles the six rigid-body degrees of freedom with form error and must be registered through datums and fiducials; it then compares the physical limits of CGH null interferometry, tilted-wave non-null interferometry, contact and optical probe profilometry and subaperture stitching, builds an uncertainty budget covering CGH writing error, substrate, retrace error and thermal drift, and closes by cross-validating two independent methods and feeding the map back into deterministic figuring and as-built re-optimisation.
scope: 依公開物理原理與官方資料編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是原廠配方、施工圖、設備操作許可或安全程序。數值均為教學假設，需依實際規格重算。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public physics and official sources. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, operating authorisation or safety procedures. Numbers are teaching assumptions and must be recalculated for real specifications.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 自由曲面 CGH 量測練習：鏡面口徑 50 mm、最大斜率 20 mrad、公差 20 nm RMS。雙程波前斜率 40 mrad，CGH 局部線距 0.633/0.04 ≈ 15.8 µm；寫入機定位誤差 50 nm 產生 50/15800 ≈ 0.0032 波 ≈ 2 nm 波前，即 1 nm 表面，取保守值 2 nm。基板面形已量測並扣除，殘留 3 nm；對準與回溯 3 nm；參考面 2 nm；熱漂移 2 nm（鋁鏡矢高 5 mm、0.02 K 對應 2.3 nm）；雜訊 1 nm。RSS = √(4+9+9+4+4+1) ≈ 5.6 nm RMS，量測比 20/5.6 ≈ 3.6:1。配準：三個定位球在 100 mm 基線上各 1 µm 不確定度 → 10 µrad 轉動 → 半口徑 25 mm 處 0.25 µm → 乘 20 mrad 得 5 nm，仍在預算內。交叉驗證：輪廓儀不確定度 8 nm，差異圖期望 RMS √(5.6² + 8²) ≈ 9.8 nm；若實測差異 25 nm，先檢查探針半徑補償（20 mrad 處 100 nm 的高度修正）與 Y 軸方向約定。數值皆為教學假設。
workedExample.textEn: Freeform CGH metrology exercise: mirror aperture 50 mm, maximum slope 20 mrad, tolerance 20 nm RMS. The double-pass wavefront slope is 40 mrad, so the CGH local line spacing is 0.633/0.04 ≈ 15.8 µm; a writer placement error of 50 nm gives 50/15800 ≈ 0.0032 waves ≈ 2 nm of wavefront, i.e. 1 nm of surface, taken conservatively as 2 nm. The substrate figure is measured and subtracted, leaving 3 nm; alignment and retrace 3 nm; reference surface 2 nm; thermal drift 2 nm (an aluminium mirror with 5 mm sag at 0.02 K gives 2.3 nm); noise 1 nm. RSS = √(4+9+9+4+4+1) ≈ 5.6 nm RMS, a test-uncertainty ratio of 20/5.6 ≈ 3.6:1. Registration: three fiducial spheres on a 100 mm baseline at 1 µm each give 10 µrad of clocking, 0.25 µm at the 25 mm half-aperture, which times 20 mrad is 5 nm, still within budget. Cross-validation: the profilometer uncertainty is 8 nm, so the expected RMS of the difference map is √(5.6² + 8²) ≈ 9.8 nm; if the measured difference is 25 nm, first check the probe-radius compensation (a 100 nm height correction at 20 mrad) and the Y-axis sign convention. All values are teaching assumptions.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表實機量測、產品額定或操作參數；改變系統邊界後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not measured hardware, product ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after changing the system boundary.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與設施背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and facility context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「無對稱軸的量測對象：自由曲面與剛體自由度」與「零位與非零位干涉的物理界限」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。

steps.title: 無對稱軸的量測對象：自由曲面與剛體自由度：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: A measurand without symmetry: freeforms and rigid-body freedom: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「自由曲面定義與基準座標」如何決定自由曲面光學量測的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Freeform definition and datum frame” determines the key performance of “Freeform-optics metrology”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 自由曲面是沒有旋轉對稱軸的光學面，通常以圓錐基面加上 XY 多項式或 Zernike 項描述，用於離軸反射系統、頭戴顯示與光束整形。量測的對象不是「面」本身，而是面相對於設計座標系的誤差：球面或旋轉對稱非球面可以靠對稱性消去部分剛體自由度，自由曲面卻讓平移、傾斜與繞軸轉動（clocking）六個自由度都和面形誤差混在一起。沒有基準面與定位標記，量到的誤差圖只是某個最佳擬合下的殘差，與設計師在系統中需要的誤差並不相同。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「自由曲面定義與基準座標」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A freeform is an optical surface without a rotational symmetry axis, usually described by a conic base plus XY polynomial or Zernike terms, and used in off-axis reflective systems, head-mounted displays and beam shaping. The measurand is not the surface itself but its error relative to the design coordinate frame: spheres and rotationally symmetric aspheres let symmetry eliminate some rigid-body degrees of freedom, whereas a freeform entangles all six, translation, tilt and clocking, with form error. Without datum surfaces and fiducials the measured map is only a residual under some best fit, not the error the designer needs in the system. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Freeform definition and datum frame”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：面上局部斜率 20 mrad 處，1 µm 的橫向配準誤差產生 0.02×1 µm = 20 nm 的假性面形誤差；繞軸轉動 10 µrad 在半口徑 25 mm 處造成 0.25 µm 的橫向位移，再乘以斜率得 5 nm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Where the local slope is 20 mrad, a 1 µm lateral registration error produces 0.02×1 µm = 20 nm of false form error; a clocking error of 10 µrad displaces the half-aperture point at 25 mm by 0.25 µm, which times the slope gives 5 nm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「自由曲面量測只要扣掉傾斜與離焦就能得到真正的面形誤差。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Removing tilt and defocus from a freeform measurement yields the true form error." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「自由曲面定義與基準座標」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Freeform definition and datum frame”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 無對稱軸的量測對象：自由曲面與剛體自由度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: A measurand without symmetry: freeforms and rigid-body freedom: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「自由曲面定義與基準座標」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Freeform definition and datum frame” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：面上局部斜率 20 mrad 處，1 µm 的橫向配準誤差產生 0.02×1 µm = 20 nm 的假性面形誤差；繞軸轉動 10 µrad 在半口徑 25 mm 處造成 0.25 µm 的橫向位移，再乘以斜率得 5 nm。若目標量測不確定度為 5 nm RMS，橫向配準必須優於約 0.2 µm、角度配準優於約 2 µrad。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Where the local slope is 20 mrad, a 1 µm lateral registration error produces 0.02×1 µm = 20 nm of false form error; a clocking error of 10 µrad displaces the half-aperture point at 25 mm by 0.25 µm, which times the slope gives 5 nm. For a target uncertainty of 5 nm RMS, lateral registration must be better than about 0.2 µm and angular registration better than about 2 µrad. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用設計的斜率圖把每個剛體自由度的單位誤差換算成假性面形圖，建立六個靈敏度圖；量測時以基準面與定位標記解出六個自由度後，把殘差圖與六個靈敏度圖做投影，確認剩餘的相關成分小於不確定度目標。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Convert a unit error in each rigid-body degree of freedom into a false form map using the design slope map to build six sensitivity maps; after solving the six degrees of freedom from datums and fiducials during measurement, project the residual map onto the six sensitivity maps and confirm that the remaining correlated content is below the uncertainty target.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 無對稱軸的量測對象：自由曲面與剛體自由度：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: A measurand without symmetry: freeforms and rigid-body freedom: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「自由曲面定義與基準座標」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Freeform definition and datum frame” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 用設計的斜率圖把每個剛體自由度的單位誤差換算成假性面形圖，建立六個靈敏度圖；量測時以基準面與定位標記解出六個自由度後，把殘差圖與六個靈敏度圖做投影，確認剩餘的相關成分小於不確定度目標。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Convert a unit error in each rigid-body degree of freedom into a false form map using the design slope map to build six sensitivity maps; after solving the six degrees of freedom from datums and fiducials during measurement, project the residual map onto the six sensitivity maps and confirm that the remaining correlated content is below the uncertainty target. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：量測軟體若對自由曲面也自動扣除離焦與像散這類「對準項」，真正的設計誤差會被當成對準誤差移除，報告顯示合格的鏡子裝進系統後波前比預期差數十奈米。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If the metrology software automatically removes defocus and astigmatism as alignment terms on a freeform as it would on a sphere, genuine design error is discarded as alignment, and a mirror reported compliant degrades the system wavefront by tens of nanometres once installed.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

steps.title: 無對稱軸的量測對象：自由曲面與剛體自由度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: A measurand without symmetry: freeforms and rigid-body freedom: failure diagnosis

steps.title: 零位與非零位干涉的物理界限：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Physical limits of null and non-null interferometry: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「CGH 線距與回溯誤差」如何決定自由曲面光學量測的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “CGH line spacing and retrace error” determines the key performance of “Freeform-optics metrology”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 干涉儀只能解析條紋間距大於兩個像素的區域，自由曲面對參考波前的斜率差讓條紋在大部分區域過密，因此有兩條路：零位測試用電腦全像片（CGH）以繞射產生與設計表面完全匹配的波前，條紋只反映誤差；非零位測試如傾斜波干涉儀用一組傾斜的點光源，使每個局部區域至少有一個光源的條紋可解析，再用已校正的光線追跡模型扣除非共路的回溯誤差。零位測試精度高但 CGH 專用於一個設計；非零位測試通用但依賴儀器模型的完整校正。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「CGH 線距與回溯誤差」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An interferometer resolves only regions where fringe spacing exceeds two pixels, and a freeform's slope difference from the reference wavefront makes fringes too dense almost everywhere, leaving two routes: a null test uses a computer-generated hologram (CGH) that diffracts a wavefront exactly matching the design surface so that fringes show only error, while a non-null test such as the tilted-wave interferometer uses an array of tilted point sources so that every local region has at least one source with resolvable fringes, then removes the non-common-path retrace error with a calibrated ray-trace model of the instrument. Null tests are the most accurate but each CGH serves one design; non-null tests are general but depend on a fully calibrated instrument model. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “CGH line spacing and retrace error”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：表面斜率 20 mrad 在雙程反射下對應 40 mrad 的波前斜率，CGH 的局部線距 d = λ/Δ(sinθ) = 0.633 µm/0.04 ≈ 15.8 µm，也等於直接測試時無法解析的條紋間距。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A surface slope of 20 mrad becomes 40 mrad of wavefront slope after double-pass reflection, so the CGH local line spacing is d = λ/Δ(sinθ) = 0.633 µm/0.04 ≈ 15.8 µm, which also equals the unresolvable fringe spacing of a direct test.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「非零位干涉儀不需要校正，因為它不用專用零位元件。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A non-null interferometer needs no calibration because it uses no dedicated null element." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「CGH 線距與回溯誤差」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “CGH line spacing and retrace error”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 零位與非零位干涉的物理界限：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Physical limits of null and non-null interferometry: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「CGH 線距與回溯誤差」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “CGH line spacing and retrace error” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：表面斜率 20 mrad 在雙程反射下對應 40 mrad 的波前斜率，CGH 的局部線距 d = λ/Δ(sinθ) = 0.633 µm/0.04 ≈ 15.8 µm，也等於直接測試時無法解析的條紋間距。寫入機的圖樣定位誤差 50 nm 造成相位誤差 50/15800 ≈ 0.0032 波，即約 2 nm 波前、1 nm 表面；定位誤差 0.5 µm 則變成 10 nm 表面誤差。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A surface slope of 20 mrad becomes 40 mrad of wavefront slope after double-pass reflection, so the CGH local line spacing is d = λ/Δ(sinθ) = 0.633 µm/0.04 ≈ 15.8 µm, which also equals the unresolvable fringe spacing of a direct test. A writer placement error of 50 nm gives a phase error of 50/15800 ≈ 0.0032 waves, about 2 nm of wavefront or 1 nm of surface; a 0.5 µm placement error would become 10 nm of surface error. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：取得 CGH 寫入機的定位誤差圖，以線距圖換算成相位誤差圖並納入預算；非零位儀器則量測一組已知球面與平面，比較模型預測與實測的回溯誤差，殘差超過預算時重新校正儀器模型參數。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Obtain the placement-error map of the CGH writer and convert it through the line-spacing map into a phase-error map for the budget; for a non-null instrument, measure a set of known spheres and flats, compare the retrace error predicted by the model with measurement, and recalibrate the model parameters when the residual exceeds budget.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「CGH 線距與回溯誤差」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。

steps.instruction: 取得 CGH 寫入機的定位誤差圖，以線距圖換算成相位誤差圖並納入預算；非零位儀器則量測一組已知球面與平面，比較模型預測與實測的回溯誤差，殘差超過預算時重新校正儀器模型參數。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。

steps.title: CGH 製作：繞射效率、鬼像與基板誤差：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: CGH fabrication: diffraction efficiency, ghosts and substrate error: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「CGH 基板、相位圖樣與對準區」如何決定自由曲面光學量測的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “CGH substrate, phase pattern and alignment zone” determines the key performance of “Freeform-optics metrology”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: CGH 是在熔融石英基板上以電子束或雷射直寫的繞射圖樣，振幅型以鉻膜遮光，相位型以蝕刻深度產生 π 相位差，效率差四倍；設計時加入載波傾斜使主測量級次與其他級次在像面上分離，避免鬼像干涉。基板本身的面形與厚度不均勻會直接疊加在測量波前上，必須事先量測並扣除；CGH 上另外寫入對準區，用回射或貓眼圖樣讓 CGH 相對干涉儀的位置與傾斜能被獨立確認。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「CGH 基板、相位圖樣與對準區」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A CGH is a diffractive pattern written by electron beam or laser on a fused-silica substrate; amplitude types block light with chrome, phase types etch a depth giving a π phase difference and are four times more efficient. A carrier tilt is added in the design so the measurement order separates from the other orders at the image plane and ghost interference is avoided. The substrate's own figure and thickness variation add directly to the measured wavefront and must be measured beforehand and subtracted; an alignment zone written on the CGH returns a retro or cat's-eye pattern so the CGH position and tilt relative to the interferometer can be confirmed independently. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “CGH substrate, phase pattern and alignment zone”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：二元振幅 CGH 的一階效率為 1/π² ≈ 10.1%，蝕刻至 π 相位的二元相位 CGH 為 4/π² ≈ 40.5%；雙程通過後回傳功率比例為效率的平方，分別約 1.0% 與 16.4%，相位型的訊號強度高 16 倍。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A binary amplitude CGH has a first-order efficiency of 1/π² ≈ 10.1%, a binary phase CGH etched to π has 4/π² ≈ 40.5%; after double pass the returned power scales with the square of efficiency, about 1.0% versus 16.4%, so the phase type delivers 16 times the signal.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「CGH 是玻璃做的，所以基板誤差可以忽略。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A CGH is made of glass, so substrate error can be neglected." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「CGH 基板、相位圖樣與對準區」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “CGH substrate, phase pattern and alignment zone”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: CGH 製作：繞射效率、鬼像與基板誤差：定量估算
steps.titleEn: CGH fabrication: diffraction efficiency, ghosts and substrate error: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「CGH 基板、相位圖樣與對準區」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “CGH substrate, phase pattern and alignment zone” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：二元振幅 CGH 的一階效率為 1/π² ≈ 10.1%，蝕刻至 π 相位的二元相位 CGH 為 4/π² ≈ 40.5%；雙程通過後回傳功率比例為效率的平方，分別約 1.0% 與 16.4%，相位型的訊號強度高 16 倍。基板面形若已量得 5 nm RMS 且不確定度 2 nm，扣除後只剩 2 nm 進入預算。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A binary amplitude CGH has a first-order efficiency of 1/π² ≈ 10.1%, a binary phase CGH etched to π has 4/π² ≈ 40.5%; after double pass the returned power scales with the square of efficiency, about 1.0% versus 16.4%, so the phase type delivers 16 times the signal. If the substrate figure is measured as 5 nm RMS with 2 nm uncertainty, only 2 nm enters the budget after subtraction. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以功率計量測零級與一級的回傳光強，確認效率與鬼像抑制符合設計；在干涉儀上先只裝 CGH 的對準區，調整到回射條紋為零後記錄位置，再以同一 CGH 量測一片已知的參考球面，核對殘差是否等於基板誤差扣除後的預期值。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure the returned power in the zeroth and first orders with a power meter to confirm efficiency and ghost suppression match the design; mount only the CGH alignment zone on the interferometer first, adjust until the retro fringes null and record the position, then measure a known reference sphere with the same CGH to check that the residual equals the expectation after substrate subtraction.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.

steps.title: CGH 製作：繞射效率、鬼像與基板誤差：量測與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「CGH 基板、相位圖樣與對準區」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “CGH substrate, phase pattern and alignment zone” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以功率計量測零級與一級的回傳光強，確認效率與鬼像抑制符合設計；在干涉儀上先只裝 CGH 的對準區，調整到回射條紋為零後記錄位置，再以同一 CGH 量測一片已知的參考球面，核對殘差是否等於基板誤差扣除後的預期值。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure the returned power in the zeroth and first orders with a power meter to confirm efficiency and ghost suppression match the design; mount only the CGH alignment zone on the interferometer first, adjust until the retro fringes null and record the position, then measure a known reference sphere with the same CGH to check that the residual equals the expectation after substrate subtraction. steps.observation: 注意干擾：蝕刻深度若偏離 π 相位 10%，零級殘留光增強並與一級形成鬼像條紋，面形圖出現與線距相關的週期性假紋，量測重複性從 1 nm 惡化到 5 nm 以上。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If the etch depth departs from π by 10%, residual zeroth-order light grows and forms ghost fringes with the first order, the figure map shows periodic artefacts tied to the line spacing, and repeatability degrades from 1 nm to over 5 nm.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

steps.objective: 說明「探針球與多波長光學探頭」如何決定自由曲面光學量測的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Probe ball and multi-wavelength optical probe” determines the key performance of “Freeform-optics metrology”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 輪廓儀以接觸探針或非接觸光學探頭沿表面掃描，不受條紋密度限制，是自由曲面量測的通用方法。接觸探針以紅寶石球接觸表面，量到的是球心軌跡，必須依局部斜率做探針半徑補償，探針力則造成赫茲接觸壓入；光學探頭（多波長干涉或共軛焦）無接觸，但對斜率與表面反射率敏感。兩者都要用高精度的運動平台或旋轉台與線性尺，量測時間長達數小時，熱漂移成為主要誤差源。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「探針球與多波長光學探頭」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A profilometer scans the surface with a contact stylus or a non-contact optical probe, is unconstrained by fringe density and is the general-purpose freeform method. A contact probe touches the surface with a ruby ball, measures the trajectory of the ball centre and therefore needs a radius compensation based on local slope, while the probe force causes Hertzian indentation; optical probes (multi-wavelength interferometric or confocal) are contact-free but sensitive to slope and surface reflectivity. Both rely on high-precision motion stages or rotary tables with linear scales, and because scans take hours, thermal drift becomes the dominant error. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Probe ball and multi-wavelength optical probe”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Hertzian contact: a probe force F = 1 mN, a ruby ball of radius R = 0.5 mm and an effective modulus E* ≈ 63 GPa for ruby on fused silica give a contact radius a = (3FR/4E*)^(1/3) ≈ 1.8 µm, an indentation δ = a²/R ≈ 6.6 nm and a peak contact pressure of about 0.15 GPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「接觸探針量到的就是表面本身的高度。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.title: 拼接量測與傾斜波的誤差累積：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Error accumulation in stitching and tilted-wave measurement: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「次口徑拼接與重疊區」如何決定自由曲面光學量測的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Subaperture stitching and overlap regions” determines the key performance of “Freeform-optics metrology”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 次口徑拼接把自由曲面分成多個小區域，每個區域傾斜到局部斜率在干涉儀可解析範圍內分別量測，再用重疊區解出各子孔徑的六個剛體參數與參考波前誤差後合成全口徑。拼接的強項是用一般球面干涉儀量任意面形，弱點是子孔徑之間的對準誤差會隨拼接鏈長度以隨機漫步方式累積，低階的整體形狀誤差最難被約束；通常搭配一次低解析度的全口徑量測或外部基準作為全域約束。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「次口徑拼接與重疊區」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Subaperture stitching divides a freeform into small regions, each tilted so the local slope falls within the interferometer's resolvable range and measured separately, then solves the six rigid-body parameters and reference-wavefront error of every subaperture from the overlaps to assemble the full aperture. Its strength is measuring arbitrary shapes with an ordinary spherical interferometer; its weakness is that alignment errors between subapertures accumulate along the stitching chain like a random walk, with the low-order global shape hardest to constrain, so a low-resolution full-aperture measurement or an external datum is usually added as a global constraint. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Subaperture stitching and overlap regions”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：每個重疊區的拼接誤差 σ_s = 2 nm、鏈長 m = 10 個重疊時，累積誤差 ≈ σ_s·√m = 2×√10 ≈ 6.3 nm；加上全域低階約束後若能把鏈長有效縮到 2，累積降為 2.8 nm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With a stitching error σ_s = 2 nm per overlap and a chain of m = 10 overlaps, the accumulated error ≈ σ_s·√m = 2×√10 ≈ 6.3 nm; with a global low-order constraint that effectively shortens the chain to 2, it falls to 2.8 nm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「子孔徑越多，拼接結果一定越準。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "More subapertures always make the stitched result more accurate." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「次口徑拼接與重疊區」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Subaperture stitching and overlap regions”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 拼接量測與傾斜波的誤差累積：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Error accumulation in stitching and tilted-wave measurement: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「次口徑拼接與重疊區」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Subaperture stitching and overlap regions” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：每個重疊區的拼接誤差 σ_s = 2 nm、鏈長 m = 10 個重疊時，累積誤差 ≈ σ_s·√m = 2×√10 ≈ 6.3 nm；加上全域低階約束後若能把鏈長有效縮到 2，累積降為 2.8 nm。子孔徑直徑 10 mm 在 20 mrad 全域斜率的表面上，局部斜率變化約 20 mrad×(10/50) = 4 mrad，接近未傾斜時 3.2 mrad 的解析上限，因此每個子孔徑都必須單獨調傾斜。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With a stitching error σ_s = 2 nm per overlap and a chain of m = 10 overlaps, the accumulated error ≈ σ_s·√m = 2×√10 ≈ 6.3 nm; with a global low-order constraint that effectively shortens the chain to 2, it falls to 2.8 nm. A 10 mm subaperture on a surface with 20 mrad global slope sees a local slope change of about 20 mrad×(10/50) = 4 mrad, close to the 3.2 mrad resolvable limit without tilting, so every subaperture must be individually tilted. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用同一片表面做兩次不同子孔徑佈局的拼接，比較兩張全口徑圖的差異 RMS 並與 σ_s√m 預測比較；再與 CGH 零位或輪廓儀的結果相減，確認低階項（像散、彗差）的差異在全域約束的不確定度內。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Stitch the same surface twice with different subaperture layouts, compare the RMS difference of the two full-aperture maps with the σ_s√m prediction; then subtract the CGH null or profilometer result and confirm that the low-order differences (astigmatism, coma) lie within the uncertainty of the global constraint.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 拼接量測與傾斜波的誤差累積：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Error accumulation in stitching and tilted-wave measurement: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「次口徑拼接與重疊區」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Subaperture stitching and overlap regions” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 用同一片表面做兩次不同子孔徑佈局的拼接，比較兩張全口徑圖的差異 RMS 並與 σ_s√m 預測比較；再與 CGH 零位或輪廓儀的結果相減，確認低階項（像散、彗差）的差異在全域約束的不確定度內。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：重疊區若只有 10% 而非建議的 30% 以上，子孔徑之間的相對傾斜解算病態，合成圖出現沿拼接邊界的「屋頂」狀折痕，被誤認為真正的面形不連續。

steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。

steps.objective: 說明「不確定度預算表與參考件」如何決定自由曲面光學量測的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Uncertainty-budget table and reference artefacts” determines the key performance of “Freeform-optics metrology”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 每種方法都要有一張不確定度預算表：干涉儀參考面、CGH 或儀器模型、對準與回溯、拼接、熱漂移與雜訊逐項列出，以均方根合成後與公差比較。追溯靠參考件：三平面法或隨機球法給出絕對參考面誤差，經國家計量機構（如 PTB）校正的球面與非球面標準件提供與長度單位的連結。熱是長時間量測的主因：工件、夾具與儀器的膨脹與折射率變化都在預算內。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「不確定度預算表與參考件」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Every method needs an uncertainty-budget table: interferometer reference, CGH or instrument model, alignment and retrace, stitching, thermal drift and noise are listed term by term, combined in quadrature and compared with the tolerance. Traceability rests on reference artefacts: the three-flat or random-ball test gives the absolute reference-surface error, and spherical and aspheric standards calibrated by a national metrology institute such as PTB link the measurement to the unit of length. Temperature dominates long measurements, so expansion and index change of the part, fixture and instrument all belong in the budget. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Uncertainty-budget table and reference artefacts”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：CGH 測試預算：CGH 圖樣 2 nm、基板 3 nm、對準與回溯 3 nm、參考面 2 nm、熱漂移 2 nm、雜訊 1 nm，RSS = √(4+9+9+4+4+1) = √31 ≈ 5.6 nm RMS，對 20 nm RMS 公差的量測比約 3.6:1。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: CGH test budget: CGH pattern 2 nm, substrate 3 nm, alignment and retrace 3 nm, reference surface 2 nm, thermal drift 2 nm, noise 1 nm, RSS = √(4+9+9+4+4+1) = √31 ≈ 5.6 nm RMS, a test-uncertainty ratio of about 3.6:1 against a 20 nm RMS tolerance.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「量測重複性好就代表不確定度小。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Good repeatability automatically means a small measurement uncertainty." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「不確定度預算表與參考件」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 量測不確定度預算與追溯：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Measurement-uncertainty budget and traceability: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「不確定度預算表與參考件」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Uncertainty-budget table and reference artefacts” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：CGH 測試預算：CGH 圖樣 2 nm、基板 3 nm、對準與回溯 3 nm、參考面 2 nm、熱漂移 2 nm、雜訊 1 nm，RSS = √(4+9+9+4+4+1) = √31 ≈ 5.6 nm RMS，對 20 nm RMS 公差的量測比約 3.6:1。熱項來源：鋁製自由曲面矢高 5 mm、α = 23×10⁻⁶ K⁻¹、溫差 0.1 K，矢高變化 5 mm×23×10⁻⁶×0.1 ≈ 11.5 nm，因此量測時溫度須穩定在約 0.02 K 以內。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: CGH test budget: CGH pattern 2 nm, substrate 3 nm, alignment and retrace 3 nm, reference surface 2 nm, thermal drift 2 nm, noise 1 nm, RSS = √(4+9+9+4+4+1) = √31 ≈ 5.6 nm RMS, a test-uncertainty ratio of about 3.6:1 against a 20 nm RMS tolerance. The thermal term comes from an aluminium freeform with 5 mm sag, α = 23×10⁻⁶ K⁻¹ and a 0.1 K change, whose sag shifts by 5 mm×23×10⁻⁶×0.1 ≈ 11.5 nm, so temperature must hold within about 0.02 K during measurement. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對每一項以實驗求值：重複量測得雜訊，拆裝重裝得對準項，參考件得參考面項，連續記錄溫度與面形得熱項；把各項的實驗值填回預算表，合成值應與整體重複性加系統誤差估計一致，並以校正標準件的量測差異驗證追溯鏈。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Evaluate each term experimentally: repeated measurements give noise, remove-and-replace cycles give alignment, reference artefacts give the reference term, and simultaneous logging of temperature and figure gives the thermal term; enter the experimental values back into the table, check that the combined value agrees with overall repeatability plus the systematic estimate, and verify the traceability chain by the measured deviation of a calibrated standard.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.instruction: 對每一項以實驗求值：重複量測得雜訊，拆裝重裝得對準項，參考件得參考面項，連續記錄溫度與面形得熱項；把各項的實驗值填回預算表，合成值應與整體重複性加系統誤差估計一致，並以校正標準件的量測差異驗證追溯鏈。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Evaluate each term experimentally: repeated measurements give noise, remove-and-replace cycles give alignment, reference artefacts give the reference term, and simultaneous logging of temperature and figure gives the thermal term; enter the experimental values back into the table, check that the combined value agrees with overall repeatability plus the systematic estimate, and verify the traceability chain by the measured deviation of a calibrated standard. steps.observation: 注意干擾：預算表若只用儀器型錄的重複性 0.5 nm 當作不確定度，忽略 3 nm 的基板與 3 nm 的回溯誤差，報告出的 2 nm 不確定度被客戶的獨立量測推翻，差異達 8 nm 時雙方都無法判定誰對。

steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.

steps.title: 量測不確定度預算與追溯：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Measurement-uncertainty budget and traceability: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「不確定度預算表與參考件」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Uncertainty-budget table and reference artefacts” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 預算表若只用儀器型錄的重複性 0.5 nm 當作不確定度，忽略 3 nm 的基板與 3 nm 的回溯誤差，報告出的 2 nm 不確定度被客戶的獨立量測推翻，差異達 8 nm 時雙方都無法判定誰對。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If the table takes the catalogue repeatability of 0.5 nm as the uncertainty and ignores 3 nm of substrate and 3 nm of retrace error, the reported 2 nm uncertainty is contradicted by the customer's independent measurement, and when the two disagree by 8 nm neither side can tell who is right. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：熱是長時間量測的主因：工件、夾具與儀器的膨脹與折射率變化都在預算內。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Temperature dominates long measurements, so expansion and index change of the part, fixture and instrument all belong in the budget.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「量測重複性好就代表不確定度小。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Good repeatability automatically means a small measurement uncertainty." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Datums, fiducials and the closed loop back to figuring" and "Independent-method cross-validation and acceptance handoff": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 基準、定位標記與回饋修形的閉環：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Datums, fiducials and the closed loop back to figuring: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「定位標記與數位製造迴路」如何決定自由曲面光學量測的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Fiducials and the digital manufacturing loop” determines the key performance of “Freeform-optics metrology”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 自由曲面的工程價值在於量測圖能被正確放回設計座標並驅動下一步：加工端用它計算修形的停留時間圖，設計端用它做實測重最佳化，裝配端用它決定補償調整。這需要在工件上設計可量測的基準：三個定位球或基準平面與邊緣，在加工機、量測機與鏡座之間共用同一套參考。定位標記本身的量測不確定度透過斜率轉成面形不確定度，因此基準的佈局要盡量拉長基線、靠近有效口徑。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「定位標記與數位製造迴路」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The engineering value of freeform metrology lies in placing the measured map correctly into the design frame and letting it drive the next step: the fabricator computes the figuring dwell-time map from it, the designer re-optimises with as-built data, and the integrator decides compensating adjustments. This needs measurable datums designed into the part, three fiducial spheres or a datum plane plus edge, shared as one reference by the machine tool, the metrology instrument and the mount. The fiducials' own measurement uncertainty converts through slope into form uncertainty, so their layout should maximise the baseline and sit close to the clear aperture. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Fiducials and the digital manufacturing loop”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：三個定位球在 100 mm 基線上各以 1 µm 不確定度量測，繞軸轉動的配準不確定度約 1 µm/100 mm = 10 µrad；在半口徑 25 mm 處造成 0.25 µm 的橫向位移，乘以 20 mrad 斜率得 5 nm 的假性面形。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Three fiducial spheres on a 100 mm baseline, each measured with 1 µm uncertainty, give a clocking registration uncertainty of about 1 µm/100 mm = 10 µrad; at the 25 mm half-aperture this displaces points laterally by 0.25 µm, which times the 20 mrad slope gives 5 nm of false form.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「自由曲面量測圖本身就足以指導修形，不需要定位標記。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A freeform measurement map alone can guide figuring without fiducials." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「定位標記與數位製造迴路」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Fiducials and the digital manufacturing loop”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 基準、定位標記與回饋修形的閉環：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Datums, fiducials and the closed loop back to figuring: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「定位標記與數位製造迴路」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Fiducials and the digital manufacturing loop” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：三個定位球在 100 mm 基線上各以 1 µm 不確定度量測，繞軸轉動的配準不確定度約 1 µm/100 mm = 10 µrad；在半口徑 25 mm 處造成 0.25 µm 的橫向位移，乘以 20 mrad 斜率得 5 nm 的假性面形。若基線縮到 30 mm，轉動不確定度升到 33 µrad，假性面形變成 17 nm，接近整個公差。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Three fiducial spheres on a 100 mm baseline, each measured with 1 µm uncertainty, give a clocking registration uncertainty of about 1 µm/100 mm = 10 µrad; at the 25 mm half-aperture this displaces points laterally by 0.25 µm, which times the 20 mrad slope gives 5 nm of false form. With the baseline shortened to 30 mm the clocking uncertainty rises to 33 µrad and the false form grows to 17 nm, close to the whole tolerance. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在量測機與加工機上各量一次定位球位置，比較兩套座標轉換後的殘差，確認基準在機台之間的轉移誤差；把量測圖經座標轉換後生成修形停留時間圖，做一次修形再量測，收斂比若低於 3 表示配準或座標方向有錯。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure the fiducial positions on both the metrology instrument and the machine tool and compare the residual after the two coordinate transformations to confirm datum transfer error between machines; generate the figuring dwell-time map from the transformed measurement, run one figuring pass and re-measure, where a convergence ratio below 3 indicates a registration or axis-direction error.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 三個定位球在 100 mm 基線上各以 1 µm 不確定度量測，繞軸轉動的配準不確定度約 1 µm/100 mm = 10 µrad；在半口徑 25 mm 處造成 0.25 µm 的橫向位移，乘以 20 mrad 斜率得 5 nm 的假性面形。若基線縮到 30 mm，轉動不確定度升到 33 µrad，假性面形變成 17 nm，接近整個公差。
knowledge.textEn: Three fiducial spheres on a 100 mm baseline, each measured with 1 µm uncertainty, give a clocking registration uncertainty of about 1 µm/100 mm = 10 µrad; at the 25 mm half-aperture this displaces points laterally by 0.25 µm, which times the 20 mrad slope gives 5 nm of false form. With the baseline shortened to 30 mm the clocking uncertainty rises to 33 µrad and the false form grows to 17 nm, close to the whole tolerance.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, obtain the actual specifications, operating conditions and uncertainties.

quiz.question: 依「基準、定位標記與回饋修形的閉環」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Datums, fiducials and the closed loop back to figuring", which statement holds?
options: 非零位干涉儀不需要校正，因為它不用專用零位元件。

A contact probe reads the surface height directly.

Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 基準、定位標記與回饋修形的閉環：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Datums, fiducials and the closed loop back to figuring: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「定位標記與數位製造迴路」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Fiducials and the digital manufacturing loop” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 在量測機與加工機上各量一次定位球位置，比較兩套座標轉換後的殘差，確認基準在機台之間的轉移誤差；把量測圖經座標轉換後生成修形停留時間圖，做一次修形再量測，收斂比若低於 3 表示配準或座標方向有錯。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure the fiducial positions on both the metrology instrument and the machine tool and compare the residual after the two coordinate transformations to confirm datum transfer error between machines; generate the figuring dwell-time map from the transformed measurement, run one figuring pass and re-measure, where a convergence ratio below 3 indicates a registration or axis-direction error. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：量測機與加工機對 Y 軸正方向的定義相反，誤差圖被鏡像後送去修形，第一次修形把誤差加倍而不是消除，連續兩次疊代後才發現是座標約定問題，浪費數天與數十微米的材料。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If the metrology instrument and the machine tool define the positive Y axis oppositely, the mirrored error map is sent to figuring, the first pass doubles the error instead of removing it, and only after two iterations is the coordinate convention found at fault, wasting days and tens of micrometres of material.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在量測機與加工機上各量一次定位球位置，比較兩套座標轉換後的殘差，確認基準在機台之間的轉移誤差；把量測圖經座標轉換後生成修形停留時間圖，做一次修形再量測，收斂比若低於 3 表示配準或座標方向有錯。
knowledge.textEn: Measure the fiducial positions on both the metrology instrument and the machine tool and compare the residual after the two coordinate transformations to confirm datum transfer error between machines; generate the figuring dwell-time map from the transformed measurement, run one figuring pass and re-measure, where a convergence ratio below 3 indicates a registration or axis-direction error.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「基準、定位標記與回饋修形的閉環」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Datums, fiducials and the closed loop back to figuring"?
options: 在量測機與加工機上各量一次定位球位置，比較兩套座標轉換後的殘差，確認基準在機台之間的轉移誤差。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。

steps.objective: 說明「交叉驗證報告與 ISO 10110-19」如何決定自由曲面光學量測的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Cross-validation report and ISO 10110-19” determines the key performance of “Freeform-optics metrology”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 自由曲面沒有簡單的通用標準件，所以驗收依賴兩種物理原理不同的方法互相比對：例如 CGH 干涉與探針輪廓儀，兩者的差異圖應在合成不確定度內且不含結構性圖樣。驗收報告依 ISO 10110-19 的自由曲面規格標示面形、斜率誤差、中頻與粗糙度，並註明所用的座標系、扣除的擬合項、取樣密度與不確定度；交接文件附上以設計座標表示的實測面形檔，供後續的實測重最佳化與系統對準使用。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「交叉驗證報告與 ISO 10110-19」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Freeforms have no simple universal standard artefact, so acceptance relies on comparing two methods of different physical principle, for example CGH interferometry and probe profilometry, whose difference map should lie within the combined uncertainty and contain no structured pattern. The acceptance report specifies figure, slope error, mid-frequency and roughness according to the freeform conventions of ISO 10110-19 and states the coordinate frame, the removed fitted terms, the sampling density and the uncertainty; the handoff package includes the as-measured surface file in design coordinates for later as-built re-optimisation and system alignment. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Cross-validation report and ISO 10110-19”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：方法 A（CGH）不確定度 5.6 nm、方法 B（輪廓儀）8 nm，兩者差異圖的期望 RMS ≈ √(5.6² + 8²) ≈ 9.8 nm；若實測差異為 25 nm RMS，超出期望 2.5 倍，表示存在系統誤差（通常是配準或探針補償），不能把兩者平均當作結果。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Method A (CGH) with 5.6 nm uncertainty and method B (profilometer) with 8 nm give an expected RMS of the difference map ≈ √(5.6² + 8²) ≈ 9.8 nm; a measured difference of 25 nm RMS, 2.5 times the expectation, signals a systematic error, usually registration or probe compensation, and the two results must not simply be averaged.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩種方法的結果不同時，取平均就是最佳估計。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "When two methods disagree, their average is the best estimate." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.

steps.title: 獨立方法交叉驗證與驗收交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Independent-method cross-validation and acceptance handoff: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「交叉驗證報告與 ISO 10110-19」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Cross-validation report and ISO 10110-19” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：方法 A（CGH）不確定度 5.6 nm、方法 B（輪廓儀）8 nm，兩者差異圖的期望 RMS ≈ √(5.6² + 8²) ≈ 9.8 nm；若實測差異為 25 nm RMS，超出期望 2.5 倍，表示存在系統誤差（通常是配準或探針補償），不能把兩者平均當作結果。差異圖若含 0.3 週期/mm 的條紋成分，可直接指向拼接或掃描線間距。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Method A (CGH) with 5.6 nm uncertainty and method B (profilometer) with 8 nm give an expected RMS of the difference map ≈ √(5.6² + 8²) ≈ 9.8 nm; a measured difference of 25 nm RMS, 2.5 times the expectation, signals a systematic error, usually registration or probe compensation, and the two results must not simply be averaged. A fringe component at 0.3 cycles/mm in the difference map points directly to stitching or scan-line spacing. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把兩種方法的面形圖在同一設計座標系下相減，計算差異的 RMS、PSD 與低階 Zernike 分量，分別與合成不確定度、各方法的頻率響應及配準不確定度比較；確認報告列出的每項規格都附量測方法、擬合項與不確定度，並由另一位工程師複核座標約定。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Subtract the two methods' maps in the same design frame, compute the RMS, PSD and low-order Zernike content of the difference and compare them respectively with the combined uncertainty, each method's frequency response and the registration uncertainty; confirm that every specification in the report carries its method, fitted terms and uncertainty, and have a second engineer check the coordinate conventions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。

steps.title: 獨立方法交叉驗證與驗收交接：量測與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「交叉驗證報告與 ISO 10110-19」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Cross-validation report and ISO 10110-19” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 把兩種方法的面形圖在同一設計座標系下相減，計算差異的 RMS、PSD 與低階 Zernike 分量，分別與合成不確定度、各方法的頻率響應及配準不確定度比較；確認報告列出的每項規格都附量測方法、擬合項與不確定度，並由另一位工程師複核座標約定。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Subtract the two methods' maps in the same design frame, compute the RMS, PSD and low-order Zernike content of the difference and compare them respectively with the combined uncertainty, each method's frequency response and the registration uncertainty; confirm that every specification in the report carries its method, fitted terms and uncertainty, and have a second engineer check the coordinate conventions. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：若驗收只用一種方法且報告未註明扣除的擬合項，系統整合時發現離軸鏡的像散比報告高 30 nm，追查時無法分辨是量測遺漏、配準錯誤還是安裝變形，整個光學系統的對準時程被打亂。

steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.
